items.title: Evan Christopher interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 1, 2009
items.q: You know if the drummer Shannon Powell calls me for a job I don’t say no.

ctx.x: No, they don’t. The jobs I do in New Orleans are mostly for some visibility, for experimenting with some things I’m working on musically and playing with good musicians. Most of my income is from touring. Oh, okay, it’s a little bit of spending money, it’s grocery money, it’s, you know, I mean I suppose if I saved it at the end of the day I might have something to show for it and I don’t work in town very often. I’m usually pretty picky. The musicians either have to be cats that I just would never say no to. You…
